title: The Evidence Room
story: A messy archive (`~/archive/`) holds ~300 decoy files across nested folders, a decoy trap directory, a scoreboard (`scores.txt`), and a single genuine `.evd` evidence file containing `EVIDENCE_MARKER_CYBERUS`.
objective:
1. Find the one `.evd` file inside `~/archive/` that contains the text `EVIDENCE_MARKER_CYBERUS` (using `find` and `grep -r`).
2. Create `~/evidence` and copy (`cp`) or move (`mv`) that file to `~/evidence/case.txt`.
3. Delete the directory `~/archive/decoy_trap` using `rm -r`.
4. Sort `~/archive/scores.txt` numerically (`sort -n`) to find the researcher handle with the highest score, and write that handle into `~/evidence/top.txt`.
5. Run `quest check` to claim your `CYBERUS{...}` flag.
hints: `find ~/archive -name "*.evd"` locates `.evd` files, and `grep -rn "EVIDENCE_MARKER_CYBERUS" ~/archive` searches file contents.
Use `mkdir -p ~/evidence`, then `cp <path> ~/evidence/case.txt`, and remove the trap folder with `rm -r ~/archive/decoy_trap`.
Run `sort -n ~/archive/scores.txt` — the highest score is on the last line! Write that researcher's name into `~/evidence/top.txt` and run `quest check`.
